ITEM.PTXT: When exposed to sunlight (ultraviolet rays), electrons (e-) are generated inside the titania layer, and the electrons pass through the silica layer and are adsorbed by and excite the surrounding oxygen (O2), changing it into active oxygen (O2-). (Fig. A) This active oxygen chemically reacts with dirt (organic matter) adhering to the silica layer surface, decomposing the dirt into carbon dioxide (CO2) and water (H2O) and removing it.
